breaking_changes: Express 4.9.5 to 5.2.1 and body-parser 1.9.0 to 2.3.0 affect middleware, routing, response, and error-handling behavior in both validation entry points.
MongoDB driver 2.x to 7.4.0 is a major API and connection-management change affecting Common directdb and frontend db-provider code.
Socket.IO/socket.io-client 1.1.0 to 4.8.3 changes protocol compatibility, server/client initialization, auth, and event semantics.

jsonwebtoken 5.x to 9.x, uuid 2.x to 14.x, winston 1.x to 3.x, nodemailer 1.x to 9.x, sharp 0.14.x to 0.35.x, csv 0.4.x to 6.x, archiver 0.14.x to 8.x, and xmlbuilder 2.x to 15.x are major-version upgrade families with direct code usage.
request, fluent-ffmpeg, and gc-stats are deprecated or unsupported packages; replacement or compatibility review is likely required.
No package-lock.json/yarn.lock/pnpm-lock.yaml files were found, so transitive dependency resolution is currently unconstrained.
risk_summary.notes: Primary language is Node.js/CommonJS JavaScript. Package manager is npm via per-package package.json manifests. Runtime entry points are tv-radio-admin/Admin/API/app.js and tv-radio-frontend/app.js; validation commands start these directly with node. No test scripts were declared in manifests.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index for tv-radio was available and queried for repository context and dependency-related symbols. Exact line locations were completed with targeted manifest reads and filtered recursive require() scans because package-level external imports were more reliably represented in source text than in graph import edges. Vendor bundles under libs/static libs were excluded from direct usage findings, but bundled library files were observed by GitNexus as additional upgrade-adjacent risk.
